subject_rule: Open to any field: 'The Mandela Rhodes Scholarship is for postgraduate study (Honours and Masters degrees) in any field.' Not funded: MBAs, any type of block course, and courses delivered predominantly online; the study must be at a South African institution of higher education.
notes: No programme list exists because the field is open; none recorded (0 per level). Applicants enter their proposed course of study on the application.
The apply page names 24 institutions where the scholarship can be held and says Masters entry requirements are set by the university department.
